title: Signals, Evidence, and Context: User Scrutiny in Real-World LLM Conversations
abstract: arXiv:2611.08232v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often present synthesized answers without making their supporting evidence easy to inspect. We study how features of these answers relate to users' subsequent accepting, checking, and challenging in 489,283 assistant-user response pairs from ShareChat and WildChat. Broad attribution language appears in 31.9% of qualifying responses, compared with explicit URLs in 1.33%, revealing a gap between claims of grounding and preserved inspectable support. Attribution, uncertainty, and other response cues generally accompany both checking and challenging; only uncertainty shows a small statistically distinguishable pooled association favoring checking. Within Technical Help, uncertainty favors checking relative to challenging; refusals and reasoning traces favor challenging in Seeking Information. translated_title: 信号、证据与语境：真实世界LLM对话中的用户审视行为
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）常常给出综合性的答案，却不让用户方便地查验其背后的支持证据。我们基于来自ShareChat和WildChat的489,283组助手-用户回复对，研究这些答案的特征如何与用户随后的接受、核查和质疑行为相关联。在符合条件的回复中，宽泛的归因语言出现率为31.9%，而显式URL仅为1.33%，这揭示了“有据可依”的声明与可查验支持证据得以保留之间的落差。归因、不确定性及其他回复线索通常同时伴随核查和质疑行为；只有不确定性在汇总统计上显示出小幅且可区分的、偏向核查的关联。在“技术求助”类别中，不确定性相对质疑更倾向于引发核查；而在“信息查询”类别中，拒绝回答和推理痕迹更倾向于引发质疑。审视行为集中于部分对话之中，而其表面上的逐轮持续性在控制上下文后会大幅缩小。
tldr: 该研究通过分析近49万条真实LLM对话发现，模型答案中宽泛的归因表述远多于可查验的显式来源链接，不确定性等回复线索与用户的核查和质疑行为相关，但用户的审视行为高度集中于少数对话。
en_tdlr: Analyzing nearly 490,000 real-world LLM conversations, this study finds that broad attribution language in model answers far outweighs inspectable explicit sources, that cues like uncertainty are associated with users' checking and challenging behaviors, and that user scrutiny is highly concentrated in a small subset of conversations.
